title: bidens cordylocarpa
intro: Bidens cordylocarpa, commonly known as Bidens, is a plant species belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Bidens cordylocarpa are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce inflammation, prevent infections, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Bidens cordylocarpa include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects and potential health benefits.
